analysis_type: Erratum and complete recomputation of the stage-58 whitened cover after identifying a sign error in the affine denominator; original files remain as invalid historical evidence, while new results use corrected denominator intervals and explicit vertex interval gates

original_state.scope: The original whitened result, receipt, report, evidence item and knowledge-graph support edges are historical only. They must not be used as valid cover evidence or as a trusted baseline for new tightening
original_state.error: The original whitened_cell_interval used +L_row4*u in d=d0-L_row4*u, reversing the denominator displacement sign

counterexample.implication: The original denominator interval excludes the actual denominator and the original prediction lower bound excludes the actual native prediction, so the original cover is not a valid conservative proof

correction_rule.denominator: d=d0-L_row4*u; the coefficients of the affine denominator form are -L_row4, not +L_row4
correction_rule.linear_term: Retain the exact affine form b1-b2*x=l0+a_L^T*L*u
correction_rule.native_interval: Only after the corrected denominator interval has a fixed nonzero sign, form reciprocal and increasing-arctangent intervals and subtract them from the exact linear interval
correction_rule.outside_rule: Retain the boundary-amendment tolerance 1e-12*(1+r^2) for outside-ball classification; do not relax denominator gates
correction_rule.unresolved_rule: A possible ball-intersecting zero-denominator cell remains unresolved and produces an unbounded union, never a finite reciprocal or prediction interval
correction_rule.vertex_gate: For every bounded union endpoint, evaluate all 16 cell vertices with the original model. Require actual denominator inside the corrected denominator interval and actual prediction inside the corrected prediction interval up to the frozen numerical tolerance; record any violation instead of hiding it
correction_rule.witness_scope: Vertex checks detect implementation errors but do not replace the complete affine cover proof or prove global optimality

baseline_rule.source: Only the stage-56 ratio_minimum, ratio_maximum and ratio_width fields stored in the original stage-58 envelopes; no original whitened grid bounds or tightening claims are trusted
baseline_rule.receipt_scope: The original receipt is used only to verify file identity and the stage-56 source receipt, not to validate the erroneous whitened cover
baseline_rule.intersection: Intersect every corrected grid union with the stage-56 baseline. Require nonempty intersections and center containment
baseline_rule.historical_comparison: Corrected results may differ from the suspended original claims; do not force agreement or edit historical numbers

comparison_rule.vertex_gate: Recompute denominator and prediction intervals at every witness and reject any interval that excludes the corresponding actual value
comparison_rule.nested_grids: Require corrected finer-grid unions and intersections to remain conservative with respect to the preceding corrected coarser grid
comparison_rule.candidate_rule: Recompute all 200 original-model candidates and 600 candidate-grid checks with corrected intervals and exact forward/inverse whitening
comparison_rule.point_accounting: Retain all 25 observations and all five fold-5 unavailable observations; fold 5 receives no cells, candidates, vertex witnesses or finite residual bounds
comparison_rule.tightening_scope: Report corrected grid-specific outcomes without presuming the original 0,17,20 tightening inventory or the original 0.820643 median ratio

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic for symmetric covariance, Cholesky factor, affine forms, inverse transforms, native intervals and vertex witnesses
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the frozen 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter conversion to evaluated native bounds and intersections
numerical_rule.vertex_tolerance: Use 1e-10 relative plus absolute tolerance only to absorb direct native-model floating evaluation differences, not to accept a substantive interval exclusion
numerical_rule.certificate_class: Corrected deterministic conservative cover with high-precision floating-point arithmetic and explicit counterexample preservation; not exact rational arithmetic or probability

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1白化覆盖勘误_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No editing or deleting original scripts, results, reports, receipts or historical protocols to conceal the error
No using original whitened bounds, tightening counts, medians or receipt as valid cover evidence
No denominator displacement with a positive L_row4 coefficient
No finite reciprocal or prediction interval for zero-containing denominator cells
No hiding vertex interval violations, unbounded unions, unresolved cells or unavailable points
No grid cells, candidates or finite residual bounds for fold 5
No exact-global-optimum, guaranteed-tightening, probability or independent-experiment claim
No replacement of stage-56 or stage-57 baselines
